transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling really down and sad all the time, and I can't seem to shake it. This constant depressed mood has been going on for about two years and four months now.
Have you had any periods of feeling back to normal or symptom-free for more than two months during this time?
No, I don't recall having any periods where I felt back to normal or better over these last two years and four months. It has just felt like a continuous, heavy cloud that never really goes away.
